info.title: The Rail customer API
info.summary: Authorization and clearing for autonomous agents.
info.description: Customer contract reference 0.1.1. Deployment support must be confirmed for your environment; this reference is not a public sandbox or a production availability guarantee. Use the endpoint and identity configuration supplied by your operator. All .invalid URLs are non-routable placeholders. Customer calls require OAuth and tenant/object authorization. Capabilities have additional sender-binding requirements. Every protected effect needs current authority. HTTP success does not establish execution, verification, or release of value. Runtime and internal-service APIs are excluded.

Id.description: Opaque identifier. Never infer authority from the identifier.

RegistryId.description: Registry identity namespace is disjoint from ledger identities.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp; use Z. Clock values do not establish cross-stream causal order.

UnsignedIntegerString.description: Exact nonnegative integer in base 10; no leading zeros.

Decimal.description: Exact nonnegative decimal, no exponent or leading zeros. Scale is retained.

SignedDecimal.description: Exact signed decimal. Negative zero is rejected semantically.

Ratio.description: Exact ratio between zero and one. Server enforces the range and total.

Metadata.description: Non-authoritative labels. Never used as an authority, policy, issuer or proof input.

JsonValue.description: JSON business payload validated against the pinned canonical schema; max serialized body 1 MiB. Never executed as code or interpreted as authorization.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, or registered unit_code on nonmonetary records.

Money.description: amount MUST have exactly scale fractional digits, or none at scale 0. All terms in a realization share currency and scale.

TimeWindow.description: end must be later than start.

Correlation.description: Retrieval association only. Never traversed as causal ancestry.

SideEffectClass.description: From the approved action-definition version, never chosen by the execution caller. Unknown classifications fail closed for retry.

Problem.description: RFC 9457. Redact policy internals, secrets and cross-tenant existence. A domain denial includes a durable denial receipt when a canonical action exists; gateway authentication failures do not claim such a receipt.

Commitment.description: Hash/HMAC input is UTF8(domain_tag) || 0x00 || canonical content. SHA-256 uses key_id=none,key_domain=public; HMAC requires tenant-bound protected keys. Signature verification never proves HMAC recomputation. See the evidence verification guide.

jws.description: RFC 7515 detached compact JWS over rail-nfc-jcs/1 bytes of the COMPLETE Commitment object. Protected alg,kid,typ=rail-commitment+jcs; only EdDSA(Ed25519) or ES256; b64=true. No private signing keys returned.

CausalParent.description: Role and requiredness are commitment-bound and issuer-authorized; producers cannot relabel a required relationship as optional.

StreamPosition.description: First record uses sequence="0" and omits previous. Subsequent records require previous and sequence+1. No global total order.

ResourceRef.description: Business object identity; not an arbitrary URL for server fetch.

ArtifactPointer.description: References bytes registered through the object upload protocol. External URLs are not fetched implicitly.

Scope.description: All dimensions are intersected with parent authority and policy; no wildcard or absent dimension expands authority. Explicit resource scopes; future predicate language requires a versioned update.

CapabilityDefinition.description: maturity_target is a request, not effective eligibility; promotion/evaluation determines effective maturity.

BindingDefinition.description: credential_ref is an opaque secret-vault handle provisioned out of band; no secret bytes.

PolicyDefinition.description: Registry admission validates deterministic bounded execution and non-overridable parent controls; missing inputs fail closed.

schema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12; references must resolve to approved immutable registry artifacts. Remote runtime resolution disabled.

TermsDefinition.description: Taxes and fees require an approved governing basis. This contract supplies no tax rates or legal conclusions.

ArtifactDefinition.description: Schema-bound extension point for versioned Rail tiers; custom data cannot bypass governance.

ProcessingGraphDefinition.description: Node/edge identifiers unique and closed; every reachable variant is evaluated, unresolved branches use least-compliant posture. Loops require an explicit bounded workflow definition.

EnergyProfileDefinition.description: Thresholds ascending; estimate strictly positive; threshold equality enters the more restrictive band. Resource mode is a generic extension; energy uses joules.

AssetVersion.description: Definition and commitment immutable. lifecycle and maturity are derived projections of governed append-only transitions.

AssetTransitionCreate.description: Publishing/graduation is separately governed; supplied approval IDs must match this exact version and quorum.

PromotionCreate.description: Always creates a new registry identity. Source ledger records remain unchanged; gate must permit registry_promotion.

PrincipalCreate.description: Issuer+subject mapping requires identity-admin authority and issuer enrollment; display names never establish identity.

AuthorityGrantCreate.description: Issuer derived from token. Root authority requires scoped tenant-governance role; child grants may only attenuate existing authority.

DelegationCreate.description: Server validates issuer controls the parent, parent receipt/request linkage, cross-tenant agreement, depth, and cumulative constraints. Parent delegation is mandatory at hop >1.

CapabilityTokenCreate.description: cnf certificate binding is derived from the active mTLS connection. Token subject must equal the caller or an explicitly authorized impersonation grant. No arbitrary cnf supplied by caller.

token.description: Sensitive opaque signed capability; returned once, redact from logs.

ReservationCreate.description: Atomic compare-and-reserve+ledger commit; caller cannot provide a fencing epoch or exclusivity proof. Expiry alone never unlocks possibly used capacity.

ReservationReleaseCreate.description: Request only. Authorized verification must establish no effect occurred or could occur before release; timeout, lease expiry or operator checkbox is insufficient.

ActionCreate.description: Exactly one input or input_artifact. Requester is resolved from authenticated context. Normalization does not authorize execution.

EvaluationCreate.description: Advisory dry run: cannot mint executable authority, reserve value or authorize dispatch. Simulation results may become stale immediately.

ExecutionCreate.description: Same operation_instance_id denotes the SAME business effect across requests/retries; independent legitimate actions use new IDs. A fresh ID cannot evade a known unresolved-effect link. Caller preferences only narrow the server-authorized set.

Execution.description: Read model over immutable evidence. completed means completion scope permitted; result_release and settlement still require their own current gate decision. HTTP 202 never means execution succeeded.

Authorization.description: Denied/conditional authorizations contain no dispatch capability. Candidate enumeration may be redacted to caller entitlement; controller validates the complete committed set.

ReconciliationCreate.description: Reconciliation performs observations or separately governed compensation consideration. It never blindly repeats the original effect.

Operation.description: Operation succeeded means the requested command finished; inspect resource and gate decision to learn whether an effect was permitted.

Approval.description: Server-generated quorum. Every voter unique; no self-approval when separation-of-duties policy prohibits it. Satisfaction triggers fresh authorization, never direct execution.

ApprovalVoteCreate.description: Approver, groups and authentication assurance derived server-side. Vote binds exact action commitment and policy versions. Votes cannot be edited; policy governs later revocation records.

ZeroRetention.description: No content persistence anywhere after processing, including logs, caches, backups, support or downstream processors. No exceptions or grace interval.

compute_class.description: Registered class such as cpu,gpu,edge,quantum,photonic or provider_service.

TargetCreate.description: Enrollment is a governed registry operation. Endpoint reachability does not establish execution eligibility.

MeasurementCreate.description: Device-local evidence; estimate production is a separately permissioned process. Pre-dispatch calibration must be a completed, safely authorized probe; no future workload measurement is fabricated.

EstimateCreate.description: Server estimator has no read access to the paired device measurement until its independently signed estimate is committed. Caller cannot submit estimate numbers.

EnergyComparison.description: Exact same target/workload/config/window/unit required; 0 or unavailable estimate never passes. Restricted is ineligible until additional conditions verified.

ObservedHop.description: Unknown identities/regions are omitted and grade=unknown; never copied from selected path as observation.

ResultEvidence.description: A signed executor assertion is still non-authoritative until scoped verification and effect gating.

DispatchEvidence.description: Key fields required for idempotent_with_key actions; reservation/fence required under single-use profiles. Binding membership rechecked immediately before each effect.

DispositionEvidence.description: Conflict resolution references and causally descends from every conflicting assertion; issuer must hold the exact scope/dimension authority.

LifecycleEvidence.description: Typed extension record for control changes, authority use, approvals, synchronization and audit; new domain payloads pin an explicit schema, never infer authority from operation text.

ContributionCreate.description: Participation assertion, not a causal allocation or payment right. Identity disclosure subject to a separate governed operation.

OutcomeCreate.description: Observed outcome remains non-authoritative at ingestion; commercial data not automatically a causal claim.

ProvenanceCreate.description: Derivation graph is acyclic. Runtime feedback is a separate correlation or explicitly versioned edge type. All referenced records tenant-visible or shared under explicit grants.

RightsCreate.description: Grantor identity and authority independently checked; a supplied grantor_id cannot impersonate a rights holder.

AllocationCreate.description: Server computes shares under one pinned method; requester cannot supply authoritative shares.

AllocationEvidence.description: Within one outcome and method: sum(positive_shares)+residual_share=1 exactly. No duplicates, no cross-method addition; negatives separate.

LotTransformationCreate.description: Server atomically reserves parent quantities and validates compatible units, authorized conversion, child+loss+waste conservation and no double-spending across transformations.

DisclosureCreate.description: Recipient must be enrolled and explicitly permitted. Disclosure is a governed action with receipts; no raw secrets returned on creation.

BeneficiaryUpdateCreate.description: Append-only succession; validates grantor/quorum/fraction/territory. Historical allocations retain then-effective beneficiaries.

DispositionTerm.description: Every term is mutually exclusive. Contributor amounts are net, not gross also counted beside deductions. Residual escrow is first class.

RealizationWitness.description: Sort terms by unique ASCII term_id before NFC+JCS. All amounts have exactly gross_value.scale digits. No mutation or later state patch of witness. Envelope uses frozen rail:receipt:v1 domain; witness_version distinguishes its type.

RealizationCreate.description: Create a proposed realization and reserve gross value under hold control; no automatic payment. Server computes mutually exclusive terms from verified evidence and approved rules.

content_id.description: Immutable commitment-derived alias: rwi_ + digest. Uses HMAC for nonpublic monetary evidence.

Realization.description: Operational id is opaque and stable; content_id appears only when the immutable witness is created. Later release/return events change aggregate views, not the witness or its alias.

EscrowAccount.description: Derived from confirmed provider funding and append-only dispositions. Account onboarding/provider credentials are operator-managed; no fictitious balance assignment API.

SettlementCreate.description: Only validated non-residual, non-returnable terms may be selected for payout. Server enforces per-term remaining balance and current settlement gate; whole terms only in this version.

ReleaseCreate.description: A command to evaluate and execute release, not evidence it happened. Current license, receipt, policy, balance and exclusive reservation rechecked at effect time.

SettlementRemediationCreate.description: Creates linked successor records/new realization where needed. Reversal is a new governed transfer, never deletion of original evidence.

RecordContent.description: Immutable assertion record. Authority to cause an operative effect is derived by verification plus a separate scoped gate. Even authorization/dispatch evidence cannot be used as an unbound bearer credential.

Receipt.description: Append-only. Signature covers complete commitment envelope. Commitment must cover content under rail:receipt:v1. Non-authoritative marking persists even after a gate permits a specific use.

DispositionCreate.description: Dedicated verifier scopes and mTLS required. Rail verifies issuer authority and signs the committed record. Submitted findings are validated before controlling a projection.

Verification.description: Signature validity only establishes signer assertion. An unavailable HMAC key yields unavailable content verification, never a synthetic pass.

ProjectionCreate.description: Requested policy/logic versions must be approved and applicable to this subject/scope; historical projections are audit snapshots only and cannot select the operative gate policy.

Projection.description: Immutable snapshot. Causal precedence, corroboration and independent dimensions apply; arrival timestamps never resolve conflict. Unknown external effects are a positive finding, distinct from missing evidence.

EffectDecisionCreate.description: Server derives current subject/scope policy, authority and minimum enforcement profile; requested profile cannot weaken that minimum. Computes a fresh projection. Old or client-chosen projections cannot force permission.

EffectDecision.description: One effect only. Informational decision IDs are not execution credentials; an enforcing service reconfirms current conditions at effect time.

InvalidationCreate.description: Recompute dependent required relationships in a bounded snapshot. Correlations never propagate; independent valid support may stop propagation. No record deletion.

VerificationKey.description: Public signing key only. EC requires y. Revocation reason/time and historical verification rules obtained under approved key policy; tenant HMAC keys never exported.

Checkpoint.description: signature covers checkpoint_commitment over the entire unsigned checkpoint core (checkpoint_version,id,stream_id,through_sequence,root_commitment,leaf_count,tree_profile); never sign only the root. See CRYPTOGRAPHY.md.

InclusionProof.description: rail-merkle/1 hashes complete canonical receipt commitments as leaves with frozen leaf/node tags; odd node promoted unchanged. See cryptography guide. Inclusion proves membership, not substantive validity.

EdgeNodeCreate.description: Bound device identity proven by active mTLS key and fresh enrollment challenge.

EdgeAllocationCreate.description: Server allocates disjoint authority units and monotonic fencing epoch. Non-overlap proved atomically; a clock-only lease cannot establish exclusive offline authority.

EdgeSyncCreate.description: Original signed records/stream order preserved. Verify node ownership, grant scope, fence, chain, signatures, gaps, replay and divergence. Offline time cannot enlarge freshness budgets.

EdgeSync.description: Per-record results mandatory. accepted ingestion is not authority to rely on results or settle. Conflicting stream segment quarantined; original bytes retained.

CoverageCreate.description: Caller completeness claim requires independently authorized inventory verification; missing verification produces unknown.

Coverage.description: Any known unmediated side door prevents covered. Gate cannot increase assurance beyond evidence.

CampaignCreate.description: Evaluates cumulative authority expansion across individually small steps and delegation descendants. Detector finding does not authorize containment.

TwinRetentionCreate.description: Separate enterprise evidence retention regime. Cannot edit or erase immutable receipts through a payload-retention command. Data erasure/legal-hold handling governed by pinned policy.

ObjectUploadCreate.description: SHA-256 transport checksum is private integrity metadata, not a public low-entropy commitment. Maximum object 100 MiB; larger chunk protocol requires a future version.

ObjectUpload.description: Short-lived, single-object signed URL. Private allowlisted destination; never log. Only exact uploaded bytes count after completion checksum/length verification.

Event.description: CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON, minimal notification; retrieve authoritative resource under OAuth. Event order cannot substitute for evidence causality.

WebhookCreate.description: Destination ownership verified by signed challenge before activation; deny loopback/private/link-local/metadata destinations after each DNS resolution, block redirects, enforce egress allowlists.

signing_secret.description: Sensitive 32-byte base64url secret returned once. Key used only for webhook HMAC.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 16–128 visible ASCII chars. Scope=(tenant,principal,HTTP method,normalized path). Atomic reservation; identical body replays original status/body for >=24h; changed canonical body=409. Pending duplicate=409 with Retry-After. Resource/operation uniqueness outlives this cache. Never reuse a key for a fresh decision.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag from latest GET of the resource. Stale=412; missing=428. Compare plus append must commit atomically.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to tenant, filters and snapshot. Invalid/expired=400; snapshot retained >=15 minutes. No offset pagination.

Traceparent.name: traceparent
Traceparent.description: W3C trace context; never an authorization input. Invalid values ignored.

Capability.name: Rail-Capability
Capability.description: Sender-bound token from createCapabilityToken. Required when grant/delegation policy requires a capability; service checks active mTLS cnf, audience, action, operation instance, expiry and replay. Not a substitute for OAuth.

ETag.description: Strong validator for this representation, including state revision.

Location.description: Relative or absolute URL of created resource / asynchronous operation for polling.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true on original response replay; absent or false on first response.

Cache-Control.description: private, no-store for tenant data, capability secrets and outcomes.

BadRequest.description: Malformed syntax, query/cursor, duplicate JSON keys or canonicalization failure.

Unauthenticated.description: Missing/invalid token or required client certificate.

WWW-Authenticate.description: OAuth bearer challenge; TLS negotiation may fail before HTTP.

Forbidden.description: Insufficient scope/role or denied governed action. Domain denials include durable receipt linkage.

NotFound.description: Resource absent or not visible; do not reveal cross-tenant existence.

Conflict.description: Idempotency mismatch/in progress, locked authority, duplicate operation, invalid transition, or unresolved external effect.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not match current representation.

PayloadTooLarge.description: JSON >1 MiB, upload >100 MiB or bounded batch exceeded.

Unprocessable.description: Schema-valid request violates a domain invariant, pinned schema, rights, unit or conservation rule.

Unavailable.description: Required policy/key/evidence/durable commit unavailable; fail closed. No dispatch or release on uncertain commit.

InternalError.description: Unexpected failure; do not infer target side-effect status from this error.

OAuth2.description: Deployment IdP. Authorization Code MUST use PKCE S256; scopes are only the first authorization layer. Client credentials for workloads, never human votes. URLs are placeholders.

post.description: At-least-once delivery for up to 72h, exponential backoff with jitter. Verify HMAC-SHA256(secret, ASCII(timestamp)+"."+UTF8(event.id)+"."+raw_request_body), constant-time compare, <=300s clock skew; reject duplicate event ID after signature verification. Persist event before 2xx. No ordering guarantee. Validate secret version; never follow URLs in event payload. See the events and webhooks guide.

204.description: Verified and durably enqueued; no response body.

401.description: Bad signature or stale timestamp; no business processing.

503.description: Temporary receiver failure; Rail retries under delivery policy.

post.description: Uses the same HMAC framing with challenge_id in place of event.id and JSON body {challenge_id,challenge}. Echo challenge in a 200 JSON response within 10 seconds; no activation on redirects, mismatch or timeout. Challenge is random, one-use, expires after 5 minutes.

503.description: Unable to receive challenge; subscription remains pending.
